address: 5/19 Mu 3, Chao Fah Tawan Tok Road, Wichit, Mueang Phuket, Phuket, 83000, Thailand
bio: This unassuming gem serves around 30-40 juicy, tender charcoal-roasted ducks every day. Order a half or whole bird and savour the wholesome flavour and crispy skin fresh off the stove with either spicy-sour or tamarind sauce for dipping. Grilled chicken is sometimes an option, too....
